units.source_text: 到了八月里，这六条院完工了，大家准备乔迁入内。

en.t: By the eighth month, the Rokujo estate was completed, and everyone prepared to move in.

units.source_text: 四区之中，未申一区，即西南一区，原是六条妃子旧邸，现在仍归她的女儿秋好皇后居住。

en.t: Of the four quarters, the hitsuji-saru quarter, that is, the southwest quarter, had originally been the old residence of the Rokujo lady, and it was still occupied by her daughter, Empress Akikonomu.

units.source_text: 辰巳向一区，即东南一区，归源氏与紫姬居住。

en.t: The tatsu-mi quarter, that is, the southeast quarter, was assigned to Genji and Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 丑寅向一区，即东北一区，归原住东院的花散里居住。

en.t: The ushi-tora quarter, that is, the northeast quarter, was given to Hanachirusato, who had formerly lived in the eastern mansion.

units.source_text: 戌亥向一区，即西北一区，预备给明石姬居住。

en.t: The inu-i quarter, that is, the northwest quarter, was prepared for the Akashi lady to live in.

units.source_text: 各处原有的池塘与假山，凡不称心者，均拆去重筑。

en.t: The ponds and artificial hills that had already existed in each place were all torn down and rebuilt wherever they were not satisfactory.

units.source_text: 流水的趣致与石山的姿态，面目一新。

en.t: The charm of the running water and the shapes of the rocky hills took on an entirely fresh appearance.

units.source_text: 各区中一切景物，都按照各女主人的好尚而布置。

en.t: All the scenery in each quarter was arranged according to the tastes of its lady.

units.source_text: 例如：紫姬所居东南一区内，石山造得很高，池塘筑得很美。

en.t: For example, in the southeast quarter where Lady Murasaki lived, the rocky hills were built very high and the ponds were made very beautiful.

units.source_text: 栽植无数春花，窗前种的是五叶松、红梅、樱花、紫藤、棣棠、踯躅等春花，布置巧妙，赏心悦目。

en.t: Countless spring flowers were planted; before the windows grew five-needle pines, red plum, cherry blossoms, wisteria, kerria, azaleas, and other spring plants, all arranged with clever grace and pleasing to the eye.

units.source_text: 其间又疏疏地杂植各种秋花。

en.t: Among them, various autumn flowers were also planted here and there with open spacing.
